faq.q: How long do the pickles stay fresh?
faq.a: Best taste within 3 months from the date of packing. Always use a clean, dry spoon and keep refrigerated after opening for longer life.

faq.q: Do you use any preservatives or colors?
faq.a: Never. We preserve naturally with salt, wood pressed oil and spices. All colour comes from natural ingredients like turmeric and red chilli.
Yes — most pickles are available both with and without garlic. You can select your preference on each product page.

faq.q: How do I place an order?
faq.a: Add items to your cart and checkout, or tap any WhatsApp button to order directly. We confirm every order personally.
